Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 8 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 23 August 2025(Saturday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan and Zambales(Olongapo, Subic, San Marcelino, Castillejos, San Narciso, San Antonio, San Felipe, Cabangan, Botolan).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Pampanga, Tarlac and Zambales(Candelaria, Iba, Masinloc, Palauig, Santa Cruz) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Rizal, Batangas(Laurel, Tanauan, Santo Tomas, Talisay, Malvar, Balete, Lipa, Mataasnakahoy, San Jose, Ibaan, Cuenca, Batangas City, San Pascual, Alitagtag, Bauan, Mabini, Taal, San Luis, Santa Teresita, San Nicolas, Agoncillo, Taysan, Lemery, Rosario, Padre Garcia, San Juan, Lobo), Bulacan(Norzagaray), Quezon(General Nakar), Metro Manila(Taguig, Paranaque, Muntinlupa, Las Pinas), Laguna(Calamba, Los Banos) and Cavite(General Trias, Imus, Bacoor, Kawit, Noveleta, Rosario, Cavite City, Dasmarinas) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
